summary:
特斯拉EPS低於預期近三成，獲利能力持續為市場焦點。
• EPS 0.24美元，低於預期0.34美元，驚喜幅度-29.32%。
• 單季營收249.0億美元，規模穩健，反映年末交付旺季。
• 能源儲能部署量為相對亮點，業務多元化持續推進。
• AI與自駕研發投入維持高檔，影響短期獲利。
• 本益比373倍，估值反映長期成長與自駕想像。
ai_view:
訊號偏負向：EPS低於預期近三成，延續獲利能力疑慮。短中期市場將緊盯毛利率能否止穩，以及AI與自駕投入是否轉化為實際營收。追蹤指標：汽車毛利率、交付量、能源部署量、營業利益率與自由現金流。在373倍本益比下，獲利改善是估值能否維持的關鍵；持續疲弱恐引發估值修正。

需留意：連續低於EPS預期，顯示成本與定價壓力未解。；缺乏營收YoY數據，難評估同比成長動能。；超高估值放大任何負面消息的股價波動。

summary_en:
Tesla misses EPS by nearly 30%, keeping profitability in focus.
• EPS of $0.24 missed the $0.34 estimate, a 29.32% shortfall.
• Quarterly revenue of $24.90B remained sizable, reflecting year-end delivery strength.
• Energy storage deployment was a relative bright spot amid diversification.
• Sustained AI and autonomy R&D spend weighed on near-term earnings.
• P/E of 373 prices in long-term growth and autonomy optionality.

ai_view_en:
Signal leans negative: EPS missed by nearly 30%, extending profitability concerns. Near to mid-term, the market will watch whether gross margins stabilize and whether AI and autonomy spend converts into revenue. Track: auto gross margin, deliveries, energy deployment, operating margin, and free cash flow. At 373x P/E, earnings improvement is key to holding the valuation; continued weakness risks a re-rating lower.

Watch：Consecutive EPS misses signal unresolved cost and pricing pressure.; Absence of revenue YoY limits assessment of year-over-year momentum.; Very high valuation amplifies share-price volatility on any negative news.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS驚喜-29.32%，獲利不及預期，營收YoY未提供。
